description: The bar chart compares the F1 scores (%) of three different models—MADLLM, MADLLM w/o skip embedding, and a third model represented by a grey bar—across five distinct datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The vertical axis represents the F1 score percentage, ranging from 80 to 100, with tick marks at 80, 90, and 100. The horizontal axis lists the five datasets. For each dataset, three bars are displayed side-by-side, with the legend indicating that the light green bar corresponds to MADLLM, the purple bar to the third model, and the light orange bar to MADLLM w/o skip embedding. In the SMD dataset, MADLLM achieves the highest F1 score, approximately 93%, followed by the third model at about 89%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at around 90%. In PSM, MADLLM again shows the highest score, around 97%, followed by the third model at about 94%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at approximately 93%. For SWaT, MADLLM has the highest score at about 91%, while the third model has the lowest at around 86%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding is at approximately 86%. In SMAP, MADLLM scores about 93%, the third model is at approximately 90%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding is at around 90%. In MSL, MADLLM achieves the highest score at about 92%, followed by the third model at approximately 89%, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding at around 89%. The chart visually indicates that MADLLM consistently outperforms or matches the other two models across all datasets, with the third model generally performing better than MADLLM w/o skip embedding.
